notes: Company snapshot: mid-stage dev tools firm building an internal developer portal + code search for 600+ engineers.
Primary ask: replace brittle grep-based search with fast, semantic code search + reranking over large monorepos and historical builds.
Corpus estimate: ~7 TB of source + 350M estimated code embeddings (current plan: sharded indexes by repo and language).
Indexing cadence: want frequent re-indexing (nightly full, hourly incremental for mainline branches). key ask: incremental delta updates without full re-embed of entire corpus.
Performance targets: p50 < 50ms and p95 < 150ms for top-10 reranking end-to-end (embedding vector search + light rerank), SLA for developer flow: sub-200ms interactive feel.
Cost constraints: aggressive per-query cost target ~<$0.01/query at current volume (100k queries/day internal peak). exploring batching + prefix caching to hit targets.
Model preferences: open to LLM reranker + smaller embedding models (quantized) for cost reasons; interested in model fallbacks across dedicated vs hosted options.
Security: SSO (SAML) mandatory, SCIM for provisioning desired, strict audit logging and KMS integration; needs to store logs for 18 months for internal compliance.
Quote from engineering lead: 'We need atomic, low-latency rerankers that can run in our VPC and obey our KMS policies. If re-indexs take >2 hours, we will not be comfortable.'
Architect asks: support for per-repo routing rules, route-based caching, and auto-fallback to cheaper quantized models during spikes.
POC plan agreed: 2-week Private cluster in us-east with 4 node dedicated GPU pool, ingest 10M representative embeddings, run ML perf bench and cost sim (open-source test harness).
Requested Redwood features: incremental index API, per-route cost breakdown, eval hooks for rerank regressions, automated quantization recommendations from Optimize.
Current integration status: SSO met with Okta team; metadata exchange pending. security questionnaire 75% complete (see Drive).
Legal/compliance: asked for data residency letter and HSM/KMS architecture for encryption at rest keys. Redwood legal reviewing attestation template.

technical_requirements_summary: Scale: target 300M+ embeddings within 12 months; sharded index per repo & language; support cross-shard reranking.
Indexing: nightly full snapshot + hourly incremental diffs. incremental ingest API + idempotent upserts required.
Query path: vector search -> candidate set -> LLM reranker (top-50 candidates). goal: end-to-end rerank <150ms p95.
Throughput: steady-state 100k q/day; burst to 500k q/day during internal demos; autoscaling/burst capacity needed.
Caching: prefix caching and KV caching for repeated dev queries; expect high query locality across teams.
Availability: 99.95% desired for dev portal; must degrade gracefully to lexical fallback when vector search degraded.
Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency histograms, rerank quality regression alerts tied to eval sets.
Compliance: must operate inside customer VPC for PII and proprietary code; KMS-managed keys, full audit logs for queries and index changes.
poC_metrics: Dataset: 10M embeddings synthetic + sampled production code (mix of python/java/js).
Lat targets: p50 < 40ms, p95 < 150ms for top-10 flow (incl. reranker).
Cost sim: model/quantization configs to demonstrate <$0.01/query at 100k q/day baseline.
Indexing perf: incremental ingest of 10k docs/minute; nightly full snapshot <2 hours for mainline subset.
Quality gates: rerank MAP@10 >= current baseline + 5% improvement (internal eval sets).
procurement_notes: Decision criteria: latency, deterministic cost forecast, SAML/KMS attestation, and long-term support SLA.
